stant. From the equations
$$\begin{aligned}
k=-a \sinh a & =b \sinh \beta=-c \frac{\sinh a \sinh \beta}{\sinh \omega}, \\
\frac{d k}{d c} & =\frac{\cosh a \cosh \beta}{\sinh \omega}, \\
\frac{d a}{d c} & =\frac{\sinh a \cosh \beta}{k \sinh \omega}, \\
\frac{d \beta}{d c} & =\frac{\cosh a \sinh \beta}{k \sinh \omega}, \\

whence we find
$$\begin{aligned}
& \frac{d q_{a a}}{d c}=\frac{\cosh a \cosh \beta}{\sinh \omega} \frac{q_{a a}}{k}-\sum_{s=0}^{s=\infty} \frac{(s c+b \cosh \beta) \cosh (\varepsilon \varpi-\alpha)}{c(\sinh (8 \varpi-\alpha))^{2}}, \\
& \frac{d q_{a b}}{d c}=\frac{\cosh a \cosh \beta}{\sinh \varpi} \frac{q_{a b}}{k}+\sum_{s=1}^{s=\infty} \frac{s \cosh s \varpi}{(\sinh s \varpi)^{2}}, \\
& \frac{d q_{b b}}{d c}=\frac{\cosh a \cosh \beta}{\sinh \varpi} q_{b b}-\sum_{s=0}^{s=\infty} \frac{(s c+a \cosh \alpha) \cosh (\beta+s \varpi)}{c(\sinh (\beta+s \varpi))^{2}} .
\end{aligned}$$
Sir William Thomson has calculated the force between two
spheres of equal radius separated by any distance less than the
diameter of one of them. For greater distances it is not neces-
sary to use more than two or three of the successive images.
The series for the differential coefficients of the $q$ 's with respect
to $c$ are easily obtained by direct differentiation,
$$\begin{aligned}
\frac{d q_{a a}}{d c}= & -\frac{2 a^{2} b c}{\left(c^{2}-b^{2}\right)^{2}}-\frac{2 a^{3} b^{2} c\left(2 c^{2}-2 b^{2}-a^{2}\right)}{\left(c^{2}-b^{2}+a c\right)^{2}\left(c^{2}-b^{2}-a c\right)^{2}}-\& \mathrm{c} . \\
\frac{d q_{a b}}{d c}= & \frac{a b}{c^{2}}+\frac{a^{2} b^{2}\left(3 c^{2}-a^{2}-b^{2}\right)}{c^{2}\left(c^{2}-a^{2}-b^{2}\right)^{2}} \\
& \quad+\frac{\left.a^{3} b^{3}\left(5 c^{2}-a^{2}-b^{2}\right)\left(c^{2}-a^{2}-b^{2}\right)-a^{2} b^{2}\right\}}{c^{2}\left(c^{2}-a^{2}-b^{2}+a b\right)^{2}\left(c^{2}-a^{2}-b^{2}-a b\right)^{2}}-\& \mathrm{c} ., \\
\frac{d q_{b b}}{d c}= & -\frac{2 a b^{2} c}{\left(c^{2}-a^{2}\right)^{2}}-\frac{2 a^{2} b^{3} c\left(2 c^{2}-2 a^{2}-b^{2}\right)}{\left(c^{2}-a^{2}+b c\right)^{2}\left(c^{2}-a^{2}-b c\right)^{2}}-\& \mathrm{c} .
\end{aligned}$$

not influenced by any point, then, if we invert the system with
respect to the point of contact, we shall have two parallel planes.
